subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The list included many __mundane__, routine tasks.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Exceptional.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the underlined word "**mundane**" in the given sentence is **"exceptional" (Option 4).**
 
• **Mundane **means** "lacking interest or excitement; dull; of this earthly world rather than a heavenly or spiritual one."** In the given sentence, mundane is used to describe routine tasks that are uninteresting or boring. (साधारण)
 
 
• For example: I'm tired of doing **mundane **tasks like washing dishes and folding laundry.
 
 
 
• **Exceptional,** on the other hand, means **"unusual, rare, or outstanding; unusually good or impressive." **(असाधारण)
 
 
• For example: She gave an **exceptional **performance in the play.
 
 
 
• Therefore, **"****exceptional" **is the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options:
 
• **Standard (Option 1)** means "a level of quality or attainment." It is not an antonym of mundane. (सामान्य, मानक)
 
• **Temporal (Option 2) **means "relating to worldly as opposed to spiritual affairs; secular." It is not an antonym of mundane. (अस्थायी,सांसारिक)
 
• **Customary (Option 3) **means "according to or depending on custom; usual." It is not an antonym of mundane. (व्यावहारिक,प्रचलित)
